confirm.description:
Add {name}?

The probe is read from its Bluetooth broadcasts only. Its readings stay raw until you calibrate it from this entry's Configure button.

user.description: Choose an iopool EcO. Only probes a Bluetooth adapter or proxy has heard recently are listed; the probe broadcasts rarely.

abort.no_devices_found: No iopool EcO heard. The probe broadcasts rarely - wake it and try again.
abort.not_supported: This device is not an iopool EcO.

add_point.title: Add a calibration point
add_point.description:
Put the probe in a reference (a pH buffer, an ORP solution, water with a thermometer in it), wait for the raw value to settle, then enter the trusted value here.

Live raw values - pH: {ph_raw}, ORP: {orp_raw}, thermistor: {temperature_raw} Ω.
Points so far - pH: {ph_points}, ORP: {orp_points}, temperature: {temperature_points}.

Each quantity needs two points at different values before it shows a reading.

data.raw: Raw value (leave blank to use the live one)

clear_points.title: Clear calibration points
clear_points.description:
Points so far - pH: {ph_points}, ORP: {orp_points}, temperature: {temperature_points}.

The chosen quantities go back to unavailable until calibrated again.

data.stale_after_minutes: Minutes without a new beacon before readings go unavailable

error.no_fresh_reading: The probe has sent no fresh reading. Wait for one, or type the raw value.
